name: Snare
overview: Scripture portrays snares as traps set to ensnare the unwary, often illustrating the consequences of wickedness and deception. Job 18:8 depicts a man caught by his own steps in a snare, symbolizing self-inflicted judgment, while Psalms 91:3 assures the believer of God's deliverance from such hidden dangers. Jeremiah 5:26 highlights how the wicked deliberately lay snares to trap others, emphasizing the devices of evil people to deceive the righteous. Amos 3:5 reinforces the certainty that snares are purposefully set to catch victims, underscoring the intentional nature of these spiritual and moral traps.
